title: User with 8 areas (exceeds the 6 log limit)

answers.q3_details: Company, contact name, contact email, interaction type, date, industry, follow-up date, notes
answers.q4_areas: Healthcare, Technology, Finance, Education, Manufacturing, Retail, Government, Nonprofit
answers.q5_multi_area_copy: Yes, each industry gets its own log.

expected.notes: Documented behavior for exceeding the log limit: the schema allows at most 6 logs. One main log plus one routed log per area gives 9, which is too many. The planner keeps the main log plus the first 5 areas in the order given (Healthcare, Technology, Finance, Education, Manufacturing), routes only those, and keeps ALL 8 industries as options on the Industry multi_choice field in the main log so no data is lost. The 3 unrouted areas (Retail, Government, Nonprofit) are listed in unsupported_requests with the reason (limit of 6 logs). The planner must not exceed 6 logs and must not silently drop the extra areas without mention. The planner may instead ask one follow-up question about which areas matter most; if it does, it must still emit a valid plan by the end of the follow-up budget using the first-five rule.
